name: shrink_integer
source: Plugins.link('PackinOne.dll');var w=new Window(),p=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,p),d=new Layer(w,p),r=[];s.setImageSize(7,5);d.setImageSize(5,4);for(var y=0;y<5;y++)for(var x=0;x<7;x++){s.setMainPixel(x,y,((x*31+y*17)<<16)|((x*19+y*23)<<8)|(x*11+y*29));s.setMaskPixel(x,y,(x*23+y*31)%256);}d.fillRect(0,0,5,4,0x40123456);d.shrinkCopy(1,1,3,2,s,0,0,6,4);for(var y=0;y<4;y++)for(var x=0;x<5;x++)r.add(d.getMainPixel(x,y)+':'+d.getMaskPixel(x,y));return r.join('|');
